description: This plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU scores and Average Lagging (AL) for four different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" and features a linear scale ranging from approximately 2.0 to 11.5, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and uses a linear scale ranging from 25 to 33, with tick marks at intervals of 1, accompanied by horizontal dashed grid lines. The "Consistency-CE" line is represented by a light purple dashed line with circle markers, showing an upward trend that starts at an x-value of approximately 2.5 with a y-value of 25.8, passes through points near (4.2, 28.0) and (8.9, 30.8), and ends at an x-value of roughly 11.2 with a y-value of 31.4. The "Inconsistency-CE" line is a dark purple dashed line with square markers that also increases across the x-axis, beginning near (2.4, 26.1), rising through (3.9, 28.1) and (6.4, 29.9), and concluding at approximately (11.2, 31.4). The "Inconsistency-CE-MP" line is depicted as a blue dashed line with square markers, following an increasing trajectory that starts at an x-value of about 2.0 and a y-value of 26.2, moves through points near (3.8, 28.0), (6.3, 30.2), and (8.9, 31.0), before ending at roughly (11.2, 31.8). Finally, the "Consistency-Bi" line is a red solid line with star markers demonstrating a steady increase, starting at an x-value of approximately 3.2 with a y-value of 28.9, progressing through points near (4.6, 29.6), (7.4, 31.2), and (10.2, 31.8), and finishing at an x-value of about 11.3 with a y-value of 32.1.
